english.notes:
This CJS Offence Code and Offence Wording is OBSOLETE as from 26/05/08. Repealed by Part 1 of Schedule 4 to The Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008.

(i) Sections 24 and 25 of the Trade Descriptions Act 1968 provide defences to the offence.
(ii) The local weights and measures authorities have the duty to enforce the Act; they have powers to make test purchases, enter premises and seize goods and documents, sections 27-29 of the Act.
(iii) Section 19 of the Act provides complex time limits for prosecution. Section 19(1) provides that no prosecution for an offence shall be commenced after the expiration of three years from the commission of the offence or one year from its discovery by the prosecutor, whichever is the earlier. Section 19(2) provides that notwithstanding anything in section 127(1) of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980, a magistrates' court may try an information for an offence if the information was laid at any time within twelve months from the commission of the offence.
